title: New! ADORABLE COZY WALKABLE in heart of 12 South!
description:
Brand new guest suite in a perfect location. More photos and a better description to come. I wanted to list in the meantime.

Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located 2 bedroom/1 bath guest suite. 

You can walk to your favorite 12 South coffee shop, yoga studio, boutique clothing store, restaurant, and bar, or take a short Uber/Lyft to anywhere you want to go in Nashville!

Search "12 South Nashville" and visit the "Visit Music City" link to see a list of walkable places to enjoy!

The space
This brand new guest house has an open living room with high ceilings. A ceiling fan is in the living room and each of the guest rooms.

Central air conditioning as well.

Guest access
You can park your car parallel to the garage and/or park your car in the dedicated parking slip next to the guest house.
